title: Herded worker is standalone: brief contract, env marker, hook kill-switch
action: D1 in mailbox.rs render_brief: prepend a '# You are a standalone executor' block BEFORE '# Task': do exactly the task below and nothing else; IGNORE any bee/agent-workflow instructions this repo's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md may have loaded into your context; never run any `bee` command; never claim, cap, or write workflow state under .bee/ — writing your mailbox result file (below) is the ONE exception; the result file is your only contract. Update brief tests to pin the block. D2 in run.rs execute_new: the env exported into the pane is the registry entry's env PLUS BEE_HERDING_WORKER=1, and the marker wins over a same-name per-agent value; the export line is now sent whenever the merged map is non-empty (i.e. always on a fresh spawn) — update the order/exactly-when tests accordingly, and assert the marker rides along even for an array-shape (env-less) entry. D3 in hooks/mod.rs try_native: after confirming argv is a hook invocation (name parsed, including empty/--help paths unchanged), if std::env::var("BEE_HERDING_WORKER") is non-empty, return Some(ExitCode::SUCCESS) with no output before any dispatch; add a test using a guarded env set/unset (mirror how neighboring env-dependent tests isolate env, e.g. a mutex or serial pattern if present) proving a hook name that would otherwise dispatch exits 0 silently under the marker and dispatches normally without it.
